description: GRIDCERF: Geospatial Raster Input Datasets for Capacity Expansion Regional Feasibility is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Kristian Nelson, Chris Vernon (Pacific Northwest National Laboratory). Geospatial Raster Input Datasets for Capacity Expansion Regional Feasibility (GRIDCERF) is a data package containing all the necessary input layers for the Capacity Expansion Regional Feasibility (CERF) model. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
